THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
021
STUDY 027
Monochrome Leather & Blunt Bangs
Rights check
Source: 24547.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight, blunt-cut
hair and wind-swept strands sits in a black-and-white
portrait. She wears a black leather zip jacket with a
wide collar and a twisted silver hoop earring. Her
expression is direct and intense. A light gray seamless
backdrop, high-contrast studio lighting, and sharp
shadows along the jaw. Monochrome palette of black,
white, and mid-gray. Sharp and graphic, in the style of
a contemporary fashion campaign.
Sharp, graphic, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The blunt bangs and leather collar are the key shapes.
- Add 'black and white film' to set the monochrome tone.
Try this: Specify black-and-white film.
